answer_1.quote: We propose a method to generate questions based on the content of the paragraph maximizing the information coverage, entity correctness & answerability of the question.

answer_2.quote: We report the BLEU and ROUGE scores that are standard metrics in Natural Language Processing literature and are a measure of overlap or common n-grams between the generated text and the ground truth.

answer_3.quote: we report the answerability score by feeding the generated question and input para to the classifier we trained (as mentioned in Reward 1 - Question Generation Section).

answer_4.quote: We conducted a small human evaluation involving 8 participants (age -27.8 ± 6.7, 2 females).
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated their experience on a 5-point scale for questions such as satisfaction with default reading, utility of persona choice, and utility of presented questions.
